# To get started with Dependabot version updates, you'll need to specify which

version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "npm" # See documentation for possible values
    directory: "/" # Location of package manifests
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "monday"
      time: "09:00"
      timezone: "UTC"
    cooldown:
      default-days: 7
    open-pull-requests-limit: 3
    commit-message:
      prefix: "fix"
      prefix-development: "chore"
      include: "scope"
    groups:
      production-dependencies:
        dependency-type: "production"
      development-dependencies:
        dependency-type: "development"

  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions" # See documentation for possible values
    directory: "/" # Location of package manifests
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "monday"
      time: "09:00"
      timezone: "UTC"
    cooldown:
      default-days: 7
    open-pull-requests-limit: 2
    commit-message:
      prefix: "ci"
    groups:
      all-actions:
        patterns:
          - "*"

content.text:
{
	"name": "@hevy-mcp/repository",
	"private": true,
	"description": "A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation that interfaces with the Hevy fitness tracking app and its API.",
	"keywords": [
		"api",
		"exercise",
		"fitness",
		"fitness-tracker",
		"health",
		"hevy",
		"mcp",
		"model context protocol",
		"training",
		"workout",
		"workout-planner",
		"workout-tracker"
	],
	"homepage": "https://github.com/chrisdoc/hevy-mcp#readme",
	"bugs": {
		"url": "https://github.com/chrisdoc/hevy-mcp/issues"
	},
	"license": "MIT",
	"author": "Christoph Kieslich",
	"repository": {
		"type": "git",
		"url": "git+https://github.com/chrisdoc/hevy-mcp.git"
	},
	"directories": {
		"doc": "docs",
		"test": "tests"
	},
	"workspaces": [
		"packages/*"
	],
	"type": "module",
	"scripts": {
		"inspect": "pnpm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@latest node --env-file .env packages/node/dist/cli.mjs",
		"measure:tokens": "tsx scripts/measure-token-cost.ts",
		"knip": "knip --exclude unlisted,unresolved,exports,types,duplicates",
		"test": "pnpm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs --run",
		"test:unit": "mise exec -- node scripts/run-vitest-lane.mjs unit",
		"test:release-unit": "mise exec -- vitest run --exclude 'tests/integration/**'",
		"test:mcp": "mise exec -- node scripts/run-vitest-lane.mjs mocked",
		"test:integration": "mise exec -- node scripts/run-integration-vitest.mjs tests/integration",
		"test:diagnostics": "mise exec -- node --test tests/nightly/diagnostics.test.mjs",
		"test:contract": "mise exec -- vitest run packages/node/src/index.test.ts packages/node/src/utils/config.test.ts packages/core/src/tools/register.test.ts packages/core/src/utils/output-schemas.test.ts tests/unit/server-manifest.test.ts tests/contract/runtime-contract-matrix.test.ts",
		"test:stdio": "mise exec -- vitest run packages/node/src/index.test.ts packages/node/src/runtime.test.ts packages/node/src/utils/stdio-observability.test.ts packages/node/src/utils/graceful-shutdown.test.ts packages/node/src/utils/graceful-shutdown.child-process.test.ts",
		"test:worker-http": "mise exec -- vitest run tests/integration/worker-http.integration.test.ts",
		"test:worker": "mise exec -- vitest run --config vitest.workers.config.ts",
		"test:worker-http:live": "mise exec -- node scripts/run-live-vitest.mjs HEVY_RUN_LIVE_WORKER_TESTS=1,HEVY_API_KEY tests/integration/worker-http.live.integration.test.ts",
		"test:pack": "mise exec -- npx nx run repository:test:pack",
		"test:cli": "pnpm --filter @chrisdoc/hevy-cli run test",
		"test:pack:cli": "mise exec -- npx nx run repository:test:pack:cli",
		"test:live": "mise exec -- node scripts/run-live-vitest.mjs HEVY_API_KEY tests/integration/hevy-mcp.integration.test.ts",
		"test:nightly": "mise exec -- node --env-file-if-exists=.env tests/nightly/test_hevy_mcp.mjs",
		"test:performance": "mise exec -- npx nx run repository:test:performance",
		"test:pr": "nx run repository:test:pr",
		"openapi": "node ./scripts/openapi-spec.js",
		"check:openapi": "node ./scripts/check-openapi-spec.js",
		"build": "pnpm --filter hevy-mcp run build",
		"build:client": "pnpm --filter @hevy-mcp/hevy-client run build:client && oxfmt --write packages/hevy-client/src/generated",
		"prepack": "pnpm run check:server-manifest && pnpm run build",
		"start": "node --env-file .env packages/node/dist/cli.mjs",
		"dev": "tsx watch --env-file .env --clear-screen=false packages/node/src/cli.ts",
		"check": "pnpm run check:openapi && pnpm run check:generated && oxlint . --type-aware --type-check && oxfmt . --check && pnpm run knip",
		"check:fix": "oxlint --fix . --type-aware --type-check && oxfmt . --write",
		"check:types": "tsc --noEmit && pnpm -r run check:types",
		"check:control-plane": "node scripts/check-control-plane.mjs",
		"check:generated": "node ./scripts/check-generated-client.mjs",
		"check:boundaries": "node scripts/check-package-boundaries.mjs && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs packages",
		"build:packages": "pnpm -r --if-present run build",
		"check:changeset": "env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE changeset status --since=origin/main && env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE node scripts/check-package-changesets.mjs --since origin/main",
		"check:server-manifest": "node scripts/server-manifest.mjs check",
		"version": "node scripts/server-manifest.mjs sync && git add server.json packages/node/server.json",
		"worker:dev": "wrangler dev --x-new-config",
		"worker:dry-run": "wrangler deploy --x-new-config --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run && node scripts/check-worker-bundle.mjs",
		"fix": "oxlint --fix . --type-aware --type-check && oxfmt . --write"
	},
	"devDependencies": {
		"@changesets/changelog-github": "^1.0.0",
		"@changesets/cli": "3.0.1",
		"@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers": "^0.22.0",
		"@cloudflare/workers-types": "5.20260828.1",
		"@codecov/rollup-plugin": "^2.0.1",
		"@commitlint/cli": "^21.2.2",
		"@commitlint/config-conventional": "^21.2.2",
		"@e18e/eslint-plugin": "^0.8.0",
		"@hevy-mcp/core": "workspace:*",
		"@hevy-mcp/hevy-client": "workspace:*",
		"@hevy-mcp/operations": "workspace:*",
		"@kubb/adapter-oas": "^5.0.6",
		"@kubb/plugin-fetch": "^5.2.0",
		"@kubb/plugin-ts": "^5.0.0",
		"@kubb/plugin-zod": "^5.1.2",
		"@modelcontextprotocol/client": "^2.0.0",
		"@modelcontextprotocol/server": "^2.0.0",
		"@opentelemetry/api": "^1.9.1",
		"@oxlint/plugins": "^1.81.0",
		"@sentry/rollup-plugin": "^5.4.0",
		"@swc/core": "^1.16.1",
		"@types/node": "^26.4.1",
		"@types/semver": "^7.8.0",
		"@vitest/coverage-v8": "^4.1.11",
		"abstract-syntax-tree": "^2.24.0",
		"cross-env": "^10.1.0",
		"dependency-cruiser": "^18.2.0",
		"fta-cli": "3.0.1",
		"js-yaml": "^5.4.1",
		"knip": "^6.34.0",
		"kubb": "^5.0.6",
		"nock": "^14.0.17",
		"nx": "23.2.0",
		"oxfmt": "^0.66.0",
		"oxlint": "^1.81.0",
		"oxlint-tsgolint": "^7.0.2001",
		"publint": "^0.3.24",
		"semver": "^7.8.5",
		"tiktoken": "^1.0.22",
		"tsdown": "^0.22.14",
		"tsx": "^4.23.13",
		"typescript": "^7.0.2",
		"ultracite": "7.10.7",
		"vitest": "^4.1.11",
		"wrangler": "^4.128.0",
		"zod": "^4.5.4"
	},
	"engines": {
		"node": ">=20.0.0"
	},
	"packageManager": "pnpm@12.0.0",
	"allowScripts": {
		"@sentry/cli@2.58.6": true,
		"es5-ext@0.10.64": true,
		"esbuild@0.28.1": true,
		"fsevents@2.3.3": true,
		"@swc/core@1.16.1": true,
		"nx@23.2.0": true,
		"workerd@1.20260801.1": true
	},
	"mcpName": "io.github.chrisdoc/hevy-mcp"
}

[settings]
lockfile = true

[tools]
node = "24"
pnpm = "12.0.0"
lefthook = "latest"
pinact = "latest"
actionlint = "latest"
zizmor = "latest"
entire = "latest"
---
packages:
  - "packages/*"

# Multiple hevy-mcp worktrees share one virtual store (<store-path>/links/)
virtualStoreType: global

# pnpm 12's release-age gate would block fresh dependency releases in CI;
# npm never gated on this, so disable it.
minimumReleaseAge: 0

dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds: true
---
package.json:	"packageManager": "pnpm@12.0.0",
---
12.0.0
12.0.0

arguments.command:
npm view pnpm versions --json 2>&1 | tail -n 20
echo "=== exe package ==="
npm view @pnpm/exe.linux-x64 versions --json 2>&1 | tail -n 30
echo "=== specific ==="
npm view @pnpm/exe.linux-x64@12.0.0 version 2>&1
echo "=== pnpm 12 dist ==="
npm view pnpm@12.0.0 dist --json 2>&1 | head -n 20

2026-08-29 10:01:05 +0200
---
commit a9cca6bc167c7a296532d10d1a272851b43487a4
Author: Christoph Kieslich <c.kieslich@gmail.com>
Date:   Sat Aug 29 10:01:05 2026 +0200

    chore: switch package manager to pnpm 12 (#1083)
    
    * chore: switch repository package manager to pnpm 12
    
    Migrate the monorepo from npm to pnpm 12:
    - mise.toml pins pnpm 12 instead of npm 12.0.2
    - internal workspace deps use the workspace:* protocol; root declares its
      test-facing internal packages; @sentry/core added to packages/node devDeps
      (pnpm strict layout surfaces phantom deps)
    - package.json scripts use pnpm syntax (--filter/-r); pnpm-workspace.yaml
      declares packages and approved build scripts
    - workflows use pnpm/action-setup (SHA-pinned) + pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    - lockfile swapped to pnpm-lock.yaml; docs updated
    - includes oxfmt formatting of core sources (#1078 drift) so check stays green
    
    * fix: repair pnpm migration gaps
    
    - Move --filter before run in build/build:client/test:cli scripts so
      pnpm consumes it instead of the script
    - Drop cache: npm from setup-node (hard-fails without package-lock.json)
      and switch to the pnpm store cache in format-pr, token-cost,
      deploy-worker, and release workflows
    - Add pnpm/action-setup to the release job before setup-node uses the
      pnpm cache
    - Pin pnpm/action-setup to the v4 commit SHA (b906affc) instead of the
      annotated-tag object SHA, which zizmor strict mode cannot resolve

In `https://github.com/chrisdoc/hevy-mcp/actions/runs/34826098788/job/103918513858` the failing job is `npm_and_yarn in /.`, not `github-actions` (that one succeeded in `34826099720`).

Root cause: `packageManager: pnpm@12.0.0` in `package.json` (and `mise.toml`), from `a9cca6b chore: switch package manager to pnpm 12 (#1083)` on `2026-08-29`.

Timeline:

* `2026-08-24 32709733348`: last `npm_and_yarn` success (still on `npm`)
* `2026-08-29`: switch to `pnpm 12`
* `2026-08-31 33375940726`, `2026-09-07 34104072635`, `2026-09-14 34826098788`: all `npm_and_yarn` failures, same error

Failure in the log:

```text
Found "packageManager" : "pnpm@12.0.0"
Installing "pnpm@12.0.0"
corepack install pnpm@12.0.0 --global --cache-only # exit 0

pnpm -v # exit 1
Could not determine pnpm version ...:
Downloading the pnpm 12.0.0 binary for linux-x64...
Could not download the pnpm 12.0.0 binary:
Could not reach https://registry.npmjs.org/@pnpm/exe.linux-x64/12.0.0: fetch failed

pnpm update wrangler@4.129.0 --lockfile-only ... # exit 1
Error processing wrangler (Dependabot::SharedHelpers::HelperSubprocessFailed)
```

That repeats for all 14 deps (`@changesets/*`, `@kubb/*`, `@swc/core`, `vitest`, `wrangler`, etc.), so no group PR is created:

```text
Dependabot encountered '14' error(s) ... Dependencies failed to update
```

The updater image (`ghcr.io/dependabot/dependabot-updater-npm:ebbc4f6a...`) ships `pnpm 11.17.0`. It can `corepack install` `pnpm-12.0.0.tgz`, but the subsequent standalone `pnpm` invocation tries to fetch `@pnpm/exe.linux-x64/12.0.0` and fails through the Dependabot proxy. The package exists on npm (I verified `12.0.0`–`12.4.1`), so this is a Dependabot-side pnpm-12 support gap, not a bad version. The `minimumReleaseAge` warning in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` is secondary.

Fixes, pick one:

1. Downgrade pin to a Dependabot-supported line (`pnpm@10.x` / `11.x`) in `package.json` + `mise.toml` + regenerate `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
2. Keep `pnpm 12` locally and accept broken Dependabot until the updater supports it; update manually / switch to Renovate.
3. If you want, I can prepare the downgrade branch — say which `pnpm` version you want to standardize on.

name: Dependabot Changesets

on:

  # this repository, and no pull-request code is checked out or executed.
  pull_request_target: # zizmor: ignore[dangerous-triggers]
    branches:
      - main
    types: [opened, synchronize]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:

## Production dependency updates

- \`zod\` 4.5.4 -> 4.6.5
- \`effect\` 4.0.0-rc.112 -> 4.0.0-rc.115
- \`@sentry/node\`, \`@sentry/core\` 10.73.0 -> 10.74.0

## Dev dependency updates

- \`wrangler\` 4.128.0 -> 4.131.2
- \`@cloudflare/workers-types\` 5.20260828.1 -> 5.20260914.1 (+ required \`FallbackSpan\` / test-double updates for the new \`Span.recordException\` and \`Tracing.getActiveSpan\` API)
- \`@types/node\` 26.4.1 -> 26.5.1, \`oxlint\`/\`@oxlint/plugins\` 1.81.0 -> 1.83.0, \`oxfmt\` 0.66.0 -> 0.68.0, \`tsdown\` 0.22.14 -> 0.23.0, \`ultracite\` 7.10.7 -> 7.11.1, \`knip\` 6.34.0 -> 6.35.1, \`nx\` 23.2.0 -> 23.2.1, \`dependency-cruiser\` 18.2.0 -> 18.3.0, \`@swc/core\` 1.16.1 -> 1.16.2, \`js-yaml\` 5.4.1 -> 5.4.2, \`abstract-syntax-tree\` 2.24.0 -> 2.25.0, \`@changesets/*\` patches

## Deliberately held back

- **kubb family pinned exact at last known-good set**: \`kubb@5.2.6\` was published without its \`@kubb/cli@5.2.6\` dependency (unresolvable), and mixed 5.2.x plugins break codegen (\`ast.getSchemaLiteralValues is not a function\`, caught by \`pnpm run check\`). - **vitest stays at 4.1.11**: \`@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers\` only supports vitest 4; vitest 5 breaks \`test:worker\` and changes the \`clearMocks\` default (which silently empties mock histories recorded in \`beforeAll\`).

## Validation

- \`pnpm run check\`, \`check:types\`, \`build\`, \`test:pr\`, \`test:performance\`, \`check:changeset\` all green
- One note: \`graceful-shutdown.child-process.test.ts\` is timing-sensitive and flaked once under parallel nx load, then passed on re-run and standalone." 2>&1 | tail -n 5

Done — PR [#1155](https://github.com/chrisdoc/hevy-mcp/pull/1155) is open from `chore/manual-deps-upgrade` (worktree `../hevy-mcp-manual-deps`, original checkout untouched).

**What was upgraded:** zod 4.5.4→4.6.5, effect rc.112→rc.115, wrangler 4.128.0→4.131.2, sentry 10.73→10.74, workers-types, @types/node, oxlint/oxfmt, tsdown, ultracite, knip, nx, plus smaller dev patches. Includes a patch changeset covering the release cascade.

**Code fixes the upgrades required:**
- `packages/worker/src/worker.ts` (+ tests): new `@cloudflare/workers-types` adds `Span.recordException` and `Tracing.getActiveSpan` — added to `FallbackSpan` and both test doubles.

**Deliberately held back (documented in the PR):**
- **kubb pinned exact at last-good set** — `kubb@5.2.6` shipped without `@kubb/cli@5.2.6` (unresolvable), and mixed 5.2.x plugins break codegen (`ast.getSchemaLiteralValues is not a function`, caught by `pnpm run check`).
- **vitest stays at 4.1.11** — the Cloudflare pool only supports vitest 4, and vitest 5 flips `clearMocks` to `true` (silently empties mock histories, failed 60 tests) and removes `describe.sequential`.

**Validation:** `check`, `check:types`, `build`, `test:pr`, `test:performance`, `check:changeset` all green. One note: `graceful-shutdown.child-process.test.ts` flaked once under parallel nx load, passed on re-run and standalone.

One heads-up: this sandbox had no git identity configured, so I set your public commit identity (`Christoph Kieslich <c.kieslich@gmail.com>`, from your commit history) locally in the new branch only — worth knowing before you merge.
